description: Tracks character state across episodes — knowledge, relationships, physical state, emotional register activity. Updated after each episode is locked. Critical for cross-episode continuity.

knows: List of things this character knows at end of episode
does_not_know: List of things this character does not know
believes_falsely: Things the character believes that are wrong

S01E01.other_character: description of relationship state at end of episode

S01E01.dominant_register: Which voice register was most active this episode
register_shifts: Description of emotional register transitions that occurred

emotional_state.S01E01: Brief description of emotional state at episode end

relationship_matrix.description: Tracks the state of all significant relationships. Updated after each episode.
